summary: Comprehensive testing of B Knockout (consolation bracket) feature for group_knockout tournaments. Backend: All 15 tests passed - tournament creation with has_b_knockout=true, knockout bracket generation with correct team placement (1st/2nd to A bracket, 3rd/4th to B bracket), result submission, finals generation, and tournament completion with both winner and winner_b. Frontend: All UI elements verified working - Tournament hub shows ongoing/completed, Tournament detail shows group standings with correct rankings, A KNOCKOUT (TOP TEAMS) and B KNOCKOUT (LOWER BRACKET) sections visible with correct styling, CHAMPION and B BRACKET WINNER banners display correctly, Create form has B Knockout toggle when group_knockout type selected.
